g.text: Forward vs. Reverse Proxy -- whose identity each one hides
One concrete request: a corporate laptop reaching an external SaaS product
from the server. The SaaS's servers
see this proxy's IP -- never the
REVERSE PROXY hides the SERVER(S) from the client. The laptop
sees one SaaS endpoint -- never which of N backends answered.
Enables: TLS termination in one place, path/header routing, and
backend topology (scaling included) fully invisible to the client.
One proxy's client is another proxy's disguise: the reverse proxy's "client" IS the
forward proxy's IP -- it never sees the real laptop at all.
